screening_reasoning: Low-cost mini-drone (DJI Mini 2 SE) agricultural monitoring for Indonesian MSMEs: U-Net semantic segmentation of land/vegetation + YOLOvX detection on 300m² vegetable plot, >90% detection accuracy. Agricultural vegetable crop/land UAV pixel-level segmentation meeting INC-01/INC-02, though system-level rather than a pure benchmark.
Enhanced U-Net extraction and 3D modeling of real road scenes from UAV imagery (F1 85.6%, mIoU 81.2%). Road-extraction domain, not crop/weed agriculture.

Comparative study of segmentation models (U-Net, SegFormer, MANet) for UAV safe landing in unstructured urban environments (Semantic Drone Dataset), optimized to Jetson Orin Nano. Urban-landing domain, not agriculture.

Drone-mounted RGB semantic segmentation of mature eggplant leaves for precision agriculture, comparing U-Net vs FPN with VGG16/VGG19 encoders; reports 94-97% leaf-segmentation accuracy with 31.5-32.6 ms latency. Agricultural vegetable crop pixel-level segmentation meeting INC-01/INC-02 with device latency for INC-03.
EVitNet lightweight CNN-Transformer segmentation to detect pine wilt disease in forest trees from drone remote sensing (IoU 0.713). Forestry domain, not crop/weed agriculture.

Survey/review paper on advancements in semantic segmentation using deep learning (SegNet, FCN, U-Net) across UAV imagery, Cityscapes, ADE20K, autonomous driving and medical imaging. Review, not a primary agricultural benchmark.

HRS-UNet hyperspectral segmentation network for precise crop classification from UAV hyperspectral imagery (UAV-HSI-Crop dataset), achieving 89.96% overall accuracy and Kappa 0.8814. Agricultural crop pixel-level classification meeting INC-01/INC-02.

PCNet physics-constrained cross-resolution network for thermal UAV image super-resolution (evaluated via downstream segmentation/detection). Super-resolution reconstruction task, not a primary agricultural crop/weed segmentation benchmark.

Lightweight CNN-Transformer with Laplacian loss for low-altitude UAV semantic segmentation enabling autonomous flight/landing (real-time 4K at 15 FPS on mobile GPU). Generic UAV perception, no agricultural crop/weed content.
Review paper on UAV vegetation monitoring and mapping in Antarctica, surveying ML/DL classifiers. Review; polar/ecology domain, not crop/weed agriculture.
HHSN-25 fully convolutional segmentation of hidden hazards (cracks, seepage) in small-scale reservoirs from UAV imagery (mIoU 87%). Reservoir-engineering/hydrology domain, not agriculture.

Self-supervised vision-only autonomous flight for small UAVs in indoor lab environments combining semantic segmentation (U-Net 1.6M) with monocular depth for obstacle avoidance. UAV navigation/perception domain, not agriculture.
Unsupervised (non-deep-learning) color-based flood-area segmentation in UAV imagery (LAB colorspace, vegetation index, distance transform) reporting 87.4% accuracy. Flood domain and non-DL method.
Concept/system for UAV near real-time mapping for disaster-response relief (orthomosaic + semantic segmentation), Austria. Disaster-response domain, not agriculture.
Critical review of ML/DL techniques for weed detection in agriculture (classic features to CNNs, YOLO, segmentation, transformers). Review/survey, not a primary experimental benchmark.
Obscured wildfire flame detection via temporal analysis of drone smoke patterns (encoder-decoder CNN, FLAME2, Dice 85.88%). Wildfire/forest-fire domain, not agriculture.

Controllable latent-diffusion data augmentation to improve generic UAV semantic-perception segmentation mIoU on UAV benchmarks. Generic UAV data-augmentation method, no agricultural crop/weed content.

Image-free single-pixel segmentation combining structured illumination with single-pixel detection and optimized reconstruction networks (Dice >80%). Novel imaging-sensing technique for generic resource-limited platforms, not an agricultural UAV segmentation benchmark.

DeepCount uses SLIC superpixels + deep CNN to classify/segment wheat spikes in field imagery for yield counting across growth stages, canopy complexity, and heights above canopy. Agricultural wheat crop pixel-level segmentation; inclusion subject to confirmation that imaging is UAV/aerial (varied canopy heights suggest airborne acquisition).
DSAFNet lightweight real-time semantic segmentation network evaluated on Cityscapes (74.78% mIoU, 74.74 FPS) and CamVid. Urban autonomous-driving domain, not agriculture.
SaferSAC deep-reinforcement-learning framework for autonomous UAV obstacle-avoidance navigation using depth-semantic fusion. UAV navigation/planning domain, not agriculture.
LDCNet lightweight dynamic-convolution semantic segmentation evaluated on Cityscapes (73.5% mIoU) and CamVid. Urban autonomous-driving domain, not agriculture.
SegFormer + atrous spatial pyramid pooling for inland water-body extraction from high-resolution UAV remote sensing (Dengzhou, Henan). Water-resource/hydrology domain, not agriculture.
Real-time semantic segmentation for UAV perspectives on embedded platforms; no abstract available to verify agricultural crop/weed domain or report metrics.

AAEHS-Net attention-based semantic segmentation evaluated on aerial-drone, Massachusetts roads, and Massachusetts buildings datasets (90-96% accuracy). Roads/buildings domain, not crop/weed agriculture.
